rules: Use Generation IV species EV vectors, not current-generation API yields.
Score complete location/area/method/time tables; each must total 100%.
Exclude partial radio and swarm replacements, one-time encounters, roamers, contests and Safari.
Keep Headbutt group and Unown unlock conditions separate.
Default to every species yielding only the chosen stat; expose mixed tables explicitly on request.
Percentages are per encountered Pokémon, not per step/cast/rock.
Average chosen EVs assumes defeating useful species and fleeing unwanted encounters.
Surfing first, followed by clean status, useful share, average chosen yield and minimum level.
No bonuses, EV-cap calculations or player progression filtering in this release.

validation.liveDeployment: Verify after push; do not infer deployment from commit success.
